high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post featuring a tattoo on someone's forearm. The tattoo depicts the mythological figure Sisyphus from Greek mythology, who was condemned to roll a boulder up a hill only for it to roll back down repeatedly. The tattoo includes a detailed illustration of Sisyphus pushing the boulder, with the sun and planets depicted around him, symbolizing the cyclical nature of his task. The tattoo is black and white, with shading that gives depth and dimension to the figures and elements.
